en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural village surrounded by fields and woodland. In the mid‑ground is a clustered settlement with a church featuring a bulbous steeple, farmhouses, and other small buildings spread across gently rolling agricultural land. At the top of the image, printed in red Gothic-style letters, is the caption identifying the place.
